title: Welcome to Bitunguramye Consulting
text:
We provide advanced statistical modeling, data cleaning, survival analysis, GIS mapping, and academic support for public health, healthcare research, and education projects.
With our epidemiology and medical background, we turn messy health data into publication-ready insights, and also help with basic websites and school applications.




Expertise in R, SAS, and GIS
Publications and research experience
Fast turnaround and professional service
Assistance with school applications and document preparation
Ability to create basic websites for personal or business use
